notes.content: DONE. Full random-packed doubly-heterogeneous k-inf assembled: new pebble_beds::keff_delta::run_keff_delta — fission-source power iteration over a reflective cube, every history streamed by delta (Woodcock) tracking through PackedSpheres (O(1) membership). Added Majorant::bounding (bin-max, sub-samples each energy bin so resonance peaks cannot slip under Sigma_maj; 0 under-bounds over 2e6 probes). triso.rs now LIVE with 5 tests. MEASURED (2026-07-15, LOW tier): doubly-het k-inf = 1.87105 +/- 0.00615 (random pf-0.30 HEU/H, 45 gens). Delta-tracking UNBIASEDNESS proven on identical homogeneous U235 reflective cube: surface 2.22081+/-0.00454 vs delta 2.21925+/-0.00320 = 0.28 sigma. Notebook has NO reference k-eff (run_mode=plot only) -> k-inf is correctness-asserted, not validated. Note: nested-lattice SURFACE tracker under-counts histories in this geometry (k~0.90 vs infinite-medium ~1.9) = the pre-existing stuck-history issue that motivates delta tracking; new delta path does not use it. Delta tracking documented in examples/triso_delta_tracking.rs + module //! docs. Manifest: docs/ai-fleet-review/op-6tz-triso-finish/REVIEW_MANIFEST.md. CSV (gitignored): verification_and_validation/openmc_notebook_comparisons/triso.csv.
